items.title: v) Inter-particle forces in solids (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: v) Inter-particle forces in solids: a main subheading of 5.11 General properties of solids, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 109-109.

blocks.text: Solids mein particles (atoms, ions, molecules) ionic, covalent, metallic ya van der Waals forces se jure hote hain. Yeh forces itni mazboot hain ke particles ko apni jagah par jama deti hain; particles sirf apni mean position ke gird vibrate kar sakte hain.
